 POINTE COUPEE PARISH, La. (WKRC) - A former police officer has been sentenced to three life terms and castration for raping three children, according to authorities.
 Pointe Coupee Parish District Attorney Tony Clayton said a jury convicted Kedreyon K. Williams of three counts of first-degree rape of juveniles, indecent behavior with a juvenile and possession of pornography involving juveniles.
 The jury deliberated for just 39 minutes before reaching its verdict.
 During sentencing, District Judge Kevin Kimball called it the “worst case” of child sexual abuse he had ever seen.
 “He performed disgusting acts on children who could not defend themselves. He is a child predator, and he deserves exactly what he is getting and more. The castration is another layer of punishment for these horrendous crimes.”
 Clayton also spoke about the sentence and the victims' families.
 “If a man takes sexual advantage of a child, and we will take his manhood!” Clayton said. “We hope the families know that justice was served here and have some comfort in knowing he will never be able to prey on any children again.”
